evidence: Serialized valid vector operand mutations remain physically well-owned but legacy opcode-shape classification can return SHAPE_EXACT. Authorize a narrow pre-byte-comparison check of action kind and decoded array count, stride, frame displacement, base adjustment and scratch-register facts from each independently bound side. Differing valid facts must report MISMATCH; malformed inputs still refuse. Keep source instructions and every nonrelocated byte in ordinary comparison too. Do not compare masked original addresses to COFF names or promote callback/helper identity from this check.

Preserve all one-span classification and non-array comparison behavior, complete original/compiled topology, every action boundary and exact relocation/bounds/ownership check, claim gates and unsupported-case refusals. No package project constants, production compiler changes or baseline resets. Both hermetic mutations and real compiler-generated count damage must exercise this comparison.
